column1: # The ascii and optimized ascii counts files of blastn -window_masker_taxid <taxid> (line NP M3d), written to
# LOSAT/target/winmask_blastn/taxid/<taxid>/wmasker.obinary by make_blastn_error_fixtures.py and tests/blastn_window_masker.rs.
# Columns: taxid, base (a file of tests/winmask/counts/, or - for an empty one), then the edits, applied to the lines of the
# base (split at each line feed; the text after the last one is the last, empty, line):
#   N=TEXT  line N (from 1) becomes TEXT (\n inserts lines; \r \t \\ as written);  cut=N  only lines 1 to N are kept, each with
#   its line feed;  crlf  the lines end with a carriage return and a line feed.
# mg1655_u9.ascii: 504 metadata lines, 505 the unit size, 506-13873 the units, 13875-14380 comments, 14382-14385 t_low, t_extend,
# t_threshold, t_high. mg1655_u9.oascii: 504 metadata lines, 505 AAAA, 506 the unit size, 507 "M k roff bc", 508-511 t_low,
# t_extend, t_threshold, t_high, 512-131583 the hash table, 131584-135277 the values table.
# The counts NCBI reads as written by windowmasker.
# Numbers and lines that give the counts of 11 and 12: a sign, spaces and tabs, hexadecimal and octal parameters, upper case,
# comments, parameters NCBI does not read (unknown, or set already); for the optimized ascii, atoi's and >>'s stops.
# Counts that mask otherwise: t_low raised by a second line (NCBI's warning at each load), unit sizes 0 and 16, no unit size
# line and no units (the default unit size 15), and the optimized ascii's truncations (t_high, a hash table line, values).
# Errors of the ascii reader: the parameters missing, a > line without a value, the conversions of the parameters (base 0),
# of the unit size and the counts (base 10) and of the units (base 16), a unit line of one field, the order of the units, a
# ##pct: line without its value, unit sizes whose window wraps (252) and above 16 (17, refused by LOSAT), the metadata's version.
# Errors of the optimized ascii reader: the unit size, the hash key size, the offset, the shift (a value >> fails to read, which
# it sets to 0), a file that ends in the header, in the hash table and in the values table, a ##pct: line, a hash table past
# the values; and a shift that >> does not reach (NCBI checks it uninitialized: refused by LOSAT).
